name: Premium discovery and live catalogue signals
description: Verifies the redesigned home renders live AniList collections and personal library signals.
steps: Wait for trending and seasonal collections
Review hero, live signals, mood shortcuts and trending shelf
expected: The home experience renders without errors and live counts appear when catalogue data is available.

name: Anime dossier on mobile
description: Checks the title profile remains readable and scrollable on a phone.
steps: Open the site at mobile width
Review metadata, cast, credits, episode guide and relations
expected: The dossier remains readable and scrollable without horizontal overflow.

name: Save and track anime progress
description: Verifies saved anime status and watched episode progress persist after refresh.
expected: The title, status and progress remain in the library after refresh.

name: Search, filter and sort anime
description: Verifies catalogue discovery controls narrow and reorder results.
steps: Filter to TV format and a release year
expected: Visible results reflect the query, filters and selected sort order.

name: Franchise release-order guide
description: Checks related anime are presented in known release-year order with their relation type and year.
steps: Open a popular anime with multiple franchise relations
Check the displayed order, year and relationship label
expected: Related anime are sorted by known release year, unknown years appear last, and selecting a relation opens its title dossier.

name: Airing calendar and library overview
description: Verifies the new airing calendar and personal library summary use available catalogue and saved data.
steps: Review titles with upcoming airing data
Review total, completed, watching and logged episode counts
expected: The calendar lists available upcoming episodes in chronological order, and library summary counts reflect saved entries.
